expressions.name: fpa_amount
expressions.expr: next((line['amount'] for line in extras['bill_calculation_lines'] if 'FPA' in line['name']), 0.0)

expressions.name: last_year_units
expressions.expr: next((row['units'] for row in extras['usage_history'] if row['month'] == 'SEP25'), 0.0)

expressions.name: summer_units
expressions.expr: sum(row['units'] for row in extras['usage_history'] if row['month'] in ['JUN26', 'JUL26', 'AUG26'])

expressions.name: winter_units
expressions.expr: sum(row['units'] for row in extras['usage_history'] if row['month'] in ['DEC25', 'JAN26', 'FEB26'])

expressions.name: unpaid_bills
expressions.expr: [row['month'] for row in extras['billing_history_rows'] if row['amount_paid'] < row['amount_billed']]

expressions.name: jun_units
expressions.expr: next((row['units'] for row in extras['usage_history'] if row['month'] == 'JUN26'), 0.0)

expressions.name: jul_units
expressions.expr: next((row['units'] for row in extras['usage_history'] if row['month'] == 'JUL26'), 0.0)

expressions.name: aug_units
expressions.expr: next((row['units'] for row in extras['usage_history'] if row['month'] == 'AUG26'), 0.0)

expressions.name: expected_units
expressions.expr: next((row['units'] for row in extras['usage_history'] if row['month'] == 'SEP25'), 0.0)

expressions.name: last_month_bill
expressions.expr: next((row['amount_billed'] for row in extras['billing_history_rows'] if row['month'] == 'AUG26'), 0.0)
